::: {#rem-reading-other-sources}

#### Reading another source's subscripts and parentheses

When you read a formula from another source,
first work out what each subscript and each argument is doing:
labeling a member of an [indexed family](sets.qmd#def-indexed-family), or being the input of a [function](functions.qmd#def-function).
That tells you which convention the source follows,
whatever its layout.

:::
